Lessons.Title: Scaling the Outputs
ExplanationParagraphs: Source-aligned goals: Calculate the scale factor $k$ needed to transform the output of a function to fit data. Describe the effect of a scale factor on the output of a function.
The transformation g(x)=k*f(x) scales every output by k; |k|>1 vertically stretches, 0<|k|<1 compresses and negative k additionally reflects across the x-axis.
